description: You are a clinical nurse specialist at a 500-bed teaching hospital. Open /home/ga/Documents/vanc_protocol_draft.docx, which is a draft clinical protocol for Vancomycin IV administration. The document contains all the necessary clinical content but is poorly structured: all text is in the same Normal style with no headings, dosage adjustment data is buried in paragraphs instead of being presented in tables, adverse reaction classifications are in running prose, and several required protocol sections are missing. Restructure this into a properly formatted clinical protocol document: apply appropriate heading hierarchy for all protocol sections (Purpose, Scope, Definitions, Indications, Dosing Guidelines, Monitoring, Adverse Reactions, Contraindications, References, Revision History), extract the dosage adjustment data from prose and create a properly formatted dosing table, create an adverse reactions classification table organizing reactions by frequency and severity, create a monitoring schedule table, add the missing required sections (Purpose, Scope, Equipment Required, Revision History), and ensure the document has professional medical document formatting throughout. Save the formatted document.

metadata.data_source: Based on IDSA/ASHP/SIDP Vancomycin Therapeutic Monitoring Guidelines (2020) - https://doi.org/10.1093/ajhp/zxaa036
